statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ is closed for the weekend, so current Tail remains low despite extreme headline and macro Stress.
recommendation: Tail remains below the blocking threshold. The principal checkpoint is the Sunday Globex reopening, where the actual gap and retracement quality can materially change the path assessment.
headline: Low current Tail, extreme Stress; Sunday reopening is the key conditional checkpoint
body: Weekend closure prevents live NQ path confirmation. Saudi security escalation, elevated oil and Treasury yields keep Stress extreme, while China's September lending benchmarks were unchanged as expected. The forecast raises Tail only around the Sunday Globex reopening, conditional on the actual gap, retracement depth and repeated extension.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 hourly assessments, Tail remained low while Stress rose from high to extreme as weekend Middle East risk accumulated. With NQ closed, later assessments correctly avoided treating headline risk as observed one-way price structure.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low through most of Sunday and rises into WATCH only around the scheduled Globex reopening. The forecast is conditional: a large gap plus shallow or failed retracements and repeated extension would sustain WATCH, while orderly two-way price discovery would support rapid normalization.

forecast.analysis: By the third post-open hour, Tail is projected back below WATCH if the opening dislocation has produced two-way trade. This remains conditional on observed retracements and lack of repeated extension.

forecast.analysis: Late in the overnight opening phase, Tail continues easing under an orderly-price-discovery scenario. A fresh geopolitical shock or persistent one-way NQ structure would invalidate that normalization path.
drivers: Orderly overnight price discovery would lower Tail
